survey.description: Chemical exposure in bleaching section, injuries not reported

evidence.summary: Photo of a bleaching area: open containers labelled sodium hypochlorite, two workers without masks or gloves, a hose on the wet floor.

conversation: I am a worker representative at the tissue mill. In the bleaching section workers handle chlorine chemicals without proper masks. The company gives cloth masks only.
Thank you. Have workers been harmed?

Yes. In July three workers had burns on their hands and one collapsed from the fumes and was taken to hospital. The company paid the hospital but did not report it as a work accident. They told him to say it happened at home.
That is serious. Has the company done anything about ventilation or equipment?
The extraction fan has been broken since May. We asked the supervisor three times. The answer is there is no budget. I uploaded a photo of the area.
Thank you. Are workers able to stop work if they feel unsafe?
No. One worker refused to go in when the fumes were strong and he lost two days of pay. Most of us are on daily contracts so we cannot refuse.
Do you know who the mill sells to?
We produce for a big Swedish hygiene brand. Their auditors came last year but the company cleaned everything the week before and told us what to say.
